propositions: Cloud identifies users by opaque accountId; Data Center identifies them by name, requiring two distinct identity resolution strategies with the same (value, authoritative, is_account_id) contract.

PR #120 hardcoded is_account_id=False for DC and consulted an unset _assignee_resolver attribute, causing the authoritative branch to be unreachable and assignee diffs to churn perpetually without converging.
NameIdentity must perform a real lookup against the DC user-search endpoint and return authoritative=True for resolvable assignees to prevent assignee-change re-emission.
Identity models receive the resolver as an explicit constructor parameter, not via getattr discovery, eliminating the unreachable-branch defect.
AccountIdIdentity returns payload shape {"accountId": ...} and NameIdentity returns {"name": ...} to match each deployment's transport requirement.
